title: Versioned device registry row from PostgreSQL logical replication (Debezium)
description: Canonical Kafka topic cf.device-registry.v1 -> ClickHouse table device_registry_versions. Frozen 2026-10-10 (schema_version 1). Key: device_id.

event_id.description: pgreg-<commit LSN>-<device_id>: stable for one committed change

device_id.description: Kafka partition key for every canonical topic

event_time.description: When the fact happened at the source (event-time analytics)

emitted_at.description: When the source system emitted/committed it (not the ingestion time)

version.description: PostgreSQL commit LSN of the change (source.lsn)

anyOf.description: RFC 3339 with an explicit offset; stored as UTC milliseconds

x-null-policy: Absent optional field == explicit null in typed storage; the normalizer counts them separately.
x-notes: On delete only the primary key is known (REPLICA IDENTITY DEFAULT): descriptive fields are null and is_deleted=true. Debezium tombstones are dropped by the normalizer after the delete event is mapped.
